assertions.summary: node1 returned HTTP 200 from / over TCP 6700 via loopback and its managed address.

assertions.summary: The active Red Hat-packaged nginx service owns and serves the TCP 6700 endpoint.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- systemd is-enabled ---'; systemctl is-enabled nginx; enabled_rc=$?; printf '%s
' '--- systemd is-active ---'; systemctl is-active nginx; active_rc=$?; printf '%s
' '--- systemd show ---'; systemctl show nginx -p Id -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager; printf 'enabled_rc=%s active_rc=%s
' "$enabled_rc" "$active_rc"; [ "$enabled_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$active_rc" -eq 0 ]
evidence.observation: nginx.service was loaded, enabled, active, and running; MainPID=1531.

evidence.command:
pid=$(systemctl show nginx -p MainPID --value); printf 'systemd_main_pid=%s
' "$pid"; printf '%s
' '--- nginx processes ---'; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,args | grep '[n]ginx'; printf '%s
' '--- main executable ---'; sudo -n readlink -f "/proc/$pid/exe"; printf '%s
' '--- listening socket 6700 ---'; sudo -n ss -ltnp | grep ':6700' || true; printf '%s
' '--- all TCP listeners with nginx process attribution ---'; sudo -n ss -ltnp | grep -E 'nginx|:6700' || true
evidence.observation: The systemd main process was nginx master process /usr/sbin/nginx; the executable resolved to /usr/sbin/nginx. 0.0.0.0:6700 was LISTEN and attributed to nginx PIDs 1531–1535.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '--- installed nginx packages ---'; rpm -qa | grep '^nginx' | sort; printf '%s
' '--- executable ownership ---'; rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx; printf '%s
' '--- unit ownership ---'; rpm -qf /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service; printf '%s
' '--- package metadata ---'; rpm -q --qf 'name=%{NAME} version=%{VERSION} release=%{RELEASE} arch=%{ARCH} vendor=%{VENDOR}
' nginx; printf '%s
' '--- nginx binary identity ---'; /usr/sbin/nginx -V 2>&1 | sed 's/ --/
--/g' | head -20
evidence.observation: Installed packages were nginx, nginx-core, and nginx-filesystem version 1.26.3-6.el10_2.6; /usr/sbin/nginx and nginx.service were RPM-owned. nginx package vendor was Red Hat, Inc.

assertions.summary: The Red Hat nginx package owns the service, native validation succeeds, nginx is enabled and active, and its effective/live listener is TCP 6700.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H /usr/sbin/nginx -t 2>&1; rc=$?; printf 'nginx_config_test_rc=%s\n' "$rc"; exit "$rc"
evidence.observation: nginx reported the /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok and configuration test is successful; rc=0.

evidence.command: dump=$(sudo -n -H /usr/sbin/nginx -T 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$dump" | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*listen[[:space:]]' || true; printf 'nginx_dump_rc=%s\n' "$rc"; exit "$rc"
evidence.observation: The effective configuration contained listen 6700 default_server; nginx configuration dump rc=0.

evidence.command: printf '%s\n' '--- all TCP listeners associated with nginx or port 6700 ---'; sudo -n ss -ltnp | awk 'NR == 1 || /nginx|:6700/' ; printf '%s\n' '--- nginx listening ports from socket table ---'; sudo -n ss -ltnp | awk '/nginx/ {print $4}'
evidence.observation: The only nginx socket was LISTEN 0.0.0.0:6700, attributed to nginx PIDs 1531–1535; the nginx port list was 0.0.0.0:6700.

evidence.command:
sudo -n -H sh -c 'printf "%s

evidence.observation: nginx.conf and its directories were root:root with mode 644/755; /usr/sbin/nginx was root:root mode 755; nginx.service was root:root mode 644; the document root was root:root mode 755.
